title: refactor(objectql): the engine sort door judges computed types by the spec's predicate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_
Fixes #37810

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感:引擎内部调用(钩子、流程)排序时判断「计算字段不能排序」,改为与 HTTP 数据接口读同一个来源,今天的结果完全不变。
- 属于排序闸门统一来源的收尾,替上一张排序闸门卡把引擎这一侧补齐,并改掉六处仍提旧集合名的注释。
- 出错的话只会是某种字段类型的排序被误拒或误放,一条测试会立刻变红;改动可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- **The engine door reads the one source.** `assertOrderByIsMaterializable` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`) judged "computed on read" with its own `type === 'formula'`. It now asks `isVirtualSearchField` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the predicate the Data API door (`assertSortFieldsExist`, third verdict) and the sortability projection already read. `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` is pinned to exactly `formula`, and `isVirtualSearchField` is true exactly for a string `type` in that set, so no verdict moves for any field, schema-valid or not. Code, status, `field`, `fields` and message are unchanged.
- **A pin holds the two doors together.** `packages/objectql/src/engine-sort-door-agreement.test.ts`: for every member of `FieldType.options` it asks the engine door and the Data API door about the same sort over the same definition, and fails if they part. It copies no verdict table. A companion field declaring `sortable: false` tells the Data API door's third verdict (computed type, names the field alone) from its fourth (names the companion), the same device as the metadata-protocol agreement test. The engine door does not judge `sortable: false`, so the companion never moves its answer. A control asserts the table has both refused and accepted types.
- **The ledger of other sites now lives beside the engine door.** The docblock gains a "ONE SOURCE" paragraph and "THE OTHER SITES" list: `fieldHasColumn` and `SqlDriver.createColumn` (driver-sql), `remote-transport.ts` (driver-turso), `planFormulaProjection` and `search-companion.ts` (objectql), `VIRTUAL_FIELD_TYPES` (plugin-audit). None of those sites changes.
- **Comments that named the retired set.** `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` (two places; the first pointed at a note that no longer exists and now points at the two doors' "ONE SOURCE" notes), `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-external-unprovisioned-sort-anchor.test.ts` (two places), and the two `ui/packages/plugin-list` tests. Comment-only.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

## Read first

1. `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`, the `assertOrderByIsMaterializable` hunk: the one-line predicate swap is the only behaviour edit in the PR.
2. `packages/objectql/src/engine-sort-door-agreement.test.ts`: how the Data API door's third verdict is told from its fourth.
3. `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts`: the rewritten pointer near the top of the docblock.

## Two-minute check

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-sort-door-agreement.test.ts` prints `Tests  50 passed (50)` (one control plus 49 field types).

## Tests

All runs at head `4edfb2fd99`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, after building the `@objectstack/objectql` dependency closure.

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck (all green)</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test
 Test Files  639 passed (639)
      Tests  14485 passed (14485)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck
check:test-typecheck: OK, the test layer compiles under packages/objectql/tsconfig.test.json (debt file unchanged)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck
check:test-typecheck: OK
pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-external-unprovisioned-sort-anchor.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  12 passed (12)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the pin goes red the day the spec's set grows without the engine door</summary>

The future case, staged on disk: `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` in `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` widened to `formula` and `summary` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), spec rebuilt, and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the widened set in 2 built files of `packages/spec/dist`. (Its tree reading answered exit 3 only because the source spells the set with single quotes and the build with double quotes; the dist reading, the one the suite consumes, passed.)

```
Leg A  engine door reads isVirtualSearchField, spec set widened   -> Tests 50 passed (50)
Leg B  engine door back to its formula literal, spec set widened  -> Tests 1 failed | 49 passed (50)
  FAIL  a `summary` field: the engine door refuses it exactly when the Data API door calls it computed
  -   "engineCallsComputed": true,
  +   "engineCallsComputed": false,
Leg C  formula literal, spec restored and rebuilt (preflight: widened set absent from all 614 built files) -> 50 passed
Leg D  this PR as committed, today's spec -> 50 passed
```

So Leg B is the drift the card describes: the Data API door refuses `summary` and the engine door lets it through. Leg A shows the change ends it, and Leg C shows the two are identical today. After restoring, both source files matched their HEAD blobs, `git status --porcelain` was empty and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **One comment outside the claimed surface still names `UNMATERIALIZED_SORT_TYPES`.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-query-validation.ts` around line 613, in the Data API door's own "ONE SOURCE" note: "This door used to carry a set of its own for the same fact (`UNMATERIALIZED_SORT_TYPES`, `formula` alone, retired here)". It is a history pointer, kept on purpose so a search for the old name lands on its replacement (contract record 7209730357, N4). The card's acceptance line reads "no comment outside CHANGELOG files", and the card's own list names the six comments edited here. The file is not in the claim, so it is left as it is and raised in the report. The shipped changeset `.changeset/37386-sort-door-reads-projection-predicate.md` does not name the set.
- **The refusal text still says "A formula field is virtual".** Unchanged on purpose: no verdict and no message moves, and `query-expression-conformance.test.ts` pins the wording across doors. The day `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` grows, that sentence needs the type name too. Noted, not filed.
- **The driver-sql anchor test still asserts `not.toBe('formula')`.** `driver-sql` depends on `@objectstack/spec`, so it could ask `isVirtualSearchField` instead. The claim makes that file comment-only, so it is left alone. Noted, not filed.
- **The pin calls the door function, not `ObjectQL.find`.** That keeps it free of an engine boot for 49 types. `query-expression-conformance.test.ts` already pins the wiring from `engine.find` / `engine.findOne` to this door.
- **The `ui/` comment edits run no local test.** Comment-only. `Test UI` covers them in CI.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (76 families for this diff) run at `4edfb2fd99`: 73 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 76 of 76 accounted for.
- NOT MEASURED, prerequisite missing in this container (CI runs all three): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3, its pinned fixture commit is out of reach of a shallow clone); `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 80 packages have no `dist/`); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (one red case, `unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts`, because `@objectstack/client` has no `dist/` here, so the files that import it could not be measured; this diff touches no `ui/` module).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 1 anchor judged, 0 lost.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main` `9b50fedbfa` and the two open PRs that share `engine-top-level.ts` (#37676, #37366).
- Dogfood: not run. The title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
